text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Epiphaneia was amazing! I thought 
that run in the Kikuka Sho was a miracle, 
but... Did she seriously just awaken?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"The one to lead the royal road after 
Orfe... could it be Epiphaneia!?"

text_block_list.name: Cheering Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah...! Epi-san was so cool! I 
think I felt a spark...♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, you!! Did you hear something!?

text_block_list.name: Cheering Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Um, wait... huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't you hear a voice deep inside calling 
out, like, 'Yeah, you can do this!'?!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no... I can't hear it... ...I-Is that 
bad?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's not bad at all! Thanks for the 
passionate cheering!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me! I'll be waiting for 
you at the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
G-Gah, so this is the legendary 'Demon 
Persuasion'... ...I'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—There was someone who felt that new spark 
of destiny. But it seemed their voice 
hasn't awakened yet!
choice_data_list: I see... That's a tough one.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry! The voice of destiny is 
telling me all we gotta do is keep 
winning!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now that more girls are looking up to us, 
if we can awaken their voices all at 
once... it'd be the best!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's charge straight down the 
royal road! Somewhere with lots of 
attention would be best, which means—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, the 'Takarazuka Kinen'! That's 
our next goal! The voices say so too!"

The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand 
Prix race. It draws huge fan attention and 
a high-caliber field. It's the perfect 
next target.
choice_data_list:
Understood, let's go with the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight!! I want to hype up the 
Takarazuka Kinen to the max!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm counting on you! You're bound 
to come up with a great idea, right?!

I'm starting to get used to Epiphaneia's 
unreasonable demands—or rather, her trust 
in me. If she wants to draw more 
attention, we just need to build up 
expectations even further.
choice_data_list:
...Announce your goals in front of 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "That's it!! Let's do that!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was really interesting too~ 
I learned so much! I'm so glad we made the 
trip~."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, isn't it kind of noisy? What's 
going on—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Our next target race is the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B & C
text_block_list.text:
A public press conference!? And they even 
set up a podium...!

After getting permission from the 
racecourse, we threw together a makeshift 
stage at lightning speed and quickly 
rounded up reporters. Thanks to that, 
we've even caught the attention of the 
departing crowd.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Rumors say that this year's Takarazuka 
Kinen will feature an ultra-luxurious 
lineup of competitors!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Boasting overwhelming strength, the Triple 
Tiara horse girl, Gentildonna! And the 
unconventional Double Crown Classic horse 
girl, Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation, overcoming her injury! And 
the indomitable Umamusume, Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Like Tosen Jordan, who once set an 
extraordinary record in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! Every name mentioned belongs to 
an incredible Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone's tough! Still, you saw 
how I ran today, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care who I'm up against, it's no 
problem at all! I'm the one who's gonna 
win—even the voice of destiny says so!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"As the face of our generation... no, the 
face of the entire racing world! I'll 
awaken the voices inside everyone in one 
fell swoop!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Talk about a bold statement! 
Man, this year's gonna be so much fu—... 
Wait, a voice?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...'Epiphaneia's doing something funny 
again'... and send. Share, share, share!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Epi-san is so cool... ...Guess I'll 
make the trip out to the Takarazuka Kinen, 
too!

"As long as Epiphaneia runs and showcases 
her full strength like she did today, more 
girls will look up to her. And then—"
choice_data_list:
(The condition for awakening the voice of 
destiny, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
How I first started hearing the voice of 
destiny...? I don't remember at all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I've been able to hear it ever since I 
was little!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is seriously the best! The 
ultimate ally who validates everything I 
want to do...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...I want to wake everyone up to this real 
soon too!

In her own way, she runs earnestly for 
everyone's happiness. Because it's such a 
precious dream, I've run alongside her, 
wishing for it to come true.

In fact, I've seen girls who claimed to 
feel destiny, so I thought it was entirely 
possible that one's voice could awaken as 
well.
choice_data_list:
(Still, the one thing that's slightly 
bothering me is—)

text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby, the voice of destiny 
pulled Epiphaneia, causing her to run 
wild. At the root of it all was the 
awakening of her fighting spirit.

I knew Epiphaneia and the voice of destiny 
were closely linked to her own will. 
However...
choice_data_list:
(It's not just close anymore— at this 
point it's more like—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's up with all that brooding?! You're 
gonna give yourself wrinkles!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Awaken~♪ Voice, voice, voice~♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: V-Voice! Voice, voice, voice, voice~♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey... could you keep your voice down? 
I'm in the middle of a critical chess move 
here?!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ruler! So you will listen to my grand 
ambitions!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll win every single race from here on 
out, bestow destiny upon everyone, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna awaken the voice inside every 
single Umamusume! Every last one of them! 
Isn't that incredible?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ……Ooh, how impressive.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're saying even that "voice of destiny" 
can be granted?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course! The voice of destiny is—

text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text: (—It's okay, I can do this!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...Man, your voice is loud... Are we 
done now?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?? Huh? What I just heard just now—
